name: MonarchPreJoinLobby
title: PreJoinLobby
wrapsNative: VStack of a preview slot (the app hosts AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer), MonarchAudioLevelMeter, MonarchCallControls (standard Toggles for microphone and camera), a devices slot for MonarchDevicePicker, MonarchPresenceAvatars and MonarchButton Join and Cancel in a ViewThatFits
summary: The screen before a call: the person's camera preview, a microphone level, microphone and camera toggles, device choice, who is already in, and Join.
whenToUse: Before starting or joining an audio or video call, in a sheet or a pushed screen, so people can check how they look and sound and join muted or with the camera off.
whenNotToUse: For answering a ringing call use the system call screen (CallKit) or the incoming-call recipe, since answering is already a choice. For changing devices during a call show MonarchDevicePicker from MonarchCallControls' devices item.

init(_ title: String? = nil, isMicOn: Binding<Bool>, audioLevel: Double = 0, participants: [MonarchPresencePerson] = [], error: String? = nil, isJoining: Bool = false, joinTitle: String? = nil, isTitleHidden: Bool = false, labels: MonarchPreJoinLobbyLabels = MonarchPreJoinLobbyLabels(), onCancel: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onJoin: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void) where Preview == EmptyView, Devices == EmptyView

options.name: title
options.description: The heading; "Join the call" by default.

options.name: isMicOn
options.description: Join with the microphone on. The microphone toggle.

options.name: isCameraOn
options.description: Join with the camera on. Shows the camera toggle; leave out for audio calls.

options.name: audioLevel
options.description: The microphone level from 0 to 1, measured by the app; values outside are clamped.

options.name: participants
options.description: People already in the call: up to five avatars and "3 already in the call".

options.name: error
options.description: A problem getting the preview or the microphone, shown as a danger notice; the preview shows No preview.

options.name: isCameraStarting
options.description: The camera is on but the app's preview is not ready: Starting camera… instead of the slot.

options.name: isJoining
options.description: Join shows a spinner and Joining…; Cancel is disabled.

options.name: joinTitle
options.description: The join button's title, such as Start call; "Join now" by default.

options.name: isTitleHidden
options.description: Hides the heading when a navigation bar already shows one.

options.name: preview
options.description: The app's camera preview, shown filling a 4:3 area while the camera is on and ready.

options.name: devices
options.description: Device choices under the toggles, usually MonarchDevicePicker with size .sm.

options.name: onJoin
options.description: Joins; the app reads the microphone and camera bindings.

states.name: camera on
states.description: The preview slot fills the 4:3 area.

states.name: camera off or audio call
states.description: A muted placeholder with a crossed-out camera and "Camera is off".

states.name: problem
states.description: The placeholder reads "No preview" with a warning symbol, and the error is a danger notice with an icon.

states.name: microphone on
states.description: A bar MonarchAudioLevelMeter named Microphone level shows the level; it is hidden while muted.

states.name: joining
states.description: Join shows a spinner and Joining…; Cancel is disabled.

states.name: large text
states.description: Join and Cancel stack full width when they do not fit side by side; the placeholder grows past the 4:3 area instead of clipping.

appearance: The preview area uses the muted background colour with muted text and a rounded container shape. The toggles keep MonarchCallControls' look (danger when a device is off). The meter uses MonarchAudioLevelMeter's colours. Join is a primary button and Cancel a ghost button. All follow the theme in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web lobby takes a MediaStream and measures the microphone with Web Audio itself; on iOS Monarch captures nothing: the app fills the preview slot (AVCaptureVideoPreviewLayer in a UIViewRepresentable) and passes the level it measures (AVAudioRecorder or AVAudioEngine metering). The web toggles are labelled "Join muted" and "Join with camera off"; iOS uses MonarchCallControls' standard toggles, read as Microphone or Camera, on or off. The web mirrors the video; mirroring is the app's preview layer's job on iOS. The web takes device picker props; iOS takes a devices slot. The web's onJoin receives the settings; on iOS the app already owns them through the bindings. Android has no lobby yet. Status experimental: it is a product composite until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The heading has the header trait.
The preview is a container named Your camera preview; its placeholder icon and text are one element.
The microphone and camera are standard toggles in a group named Microphone and camera, read with their on or off state; the symbol changes as well as the colour.
The level meter is MonarchAudioLevelMeter named Microphone level.
The avatars and "2 already in the call" are read as one element.
An error is shown with an icon and text, not colour alone.
Join and Cancel are standard buttons of at least 44 points; Join reads Joining… while busy.
edgeCases: An audio level outside 0 to 1, or not a number, is clamped to the range.
isCameraOn left out means an audio call: no camera toggle and the Camera is off placeholder.
An error wins over the camera state, so the preview slot is not shown while there is a problem.
Long titles and join titles wrap; the action row stacks at large text sizes.
